flowchart.name: Flowchart
examples:
flowchart TD
Node1[Label Text] --> Node2{Decision}
Node2 -->|Option A| Node3[Result A]
Node2 -->|Option B| Node4[Result B]
tips: Node IDs must be single words without spaces
Labels go INSIDE brackets: A[My Label]
Use --> for arrows, -->|text| for labeled arrows

sequenceDiagram.name: Sequence Diagram
sequenceDiagram.edgeSyntax: A ->> B: message or A -->> B: dotted message
examples:
sequenceDiagram
participant Entity1
participant Entity2
Entity1 ->> Entity2: Message description
Entity2 -->> Entity1: Response description
tips: Use 'as' for display names: participant U as User
Can use actor instead of participant

classDiagram.name: Class Diagram
examples:
classDiagram
class ClassName {
+String attribute
+method()
}
class AnotherClass
ClassName <|-- AnotherClass
tips: Define classes with attributes and methods

erDiagram.name: Entity Relationship Diagram
tips: Use ||--o{ and similar cardinality markers for relationships

stateDiagram-v2.name: State Diagram
examples:
stateDiagram-v2
[*] --> Pending
Pending --> Paid : capture
Paid --> [*]
tips: Use [*] for start and end states
Put transition labels after a colon

gantt.name: Gantt Chart
examples:
gantt
title Release
dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
section Work
Build :2026-09-01, 7d
tips: Give each task a duration or date range

pie.name: Pie Chart
pie.edgeSyntax: Each slice is a labeled value
tips: Use one quoted label and numeric value per slice

mindmap.name: Mind Map
mindmap.edgeSyntax: Indent child ideas beneath their parent

gitGraph.name: Git Graph
examples:
gitGraph
  commit id: "Initial"
  branch feature
  checkout feature
  commit id: "Work"

journey.name: User Journey
examples:
journey
  title User onboarding
  section Signup
    Create account: 5: User

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.edgeSyntax: Events are ordered by their timeline entries
examples:
timeline
  title Product history
  2024 : Prototype
  2025 : Public launch
tips: Use one dated entry per line
